criteria.requirement: Add Interval.coalesce(max_gap, metric=None, *, report=False). Bridge consecutive normalized atomic pieces when their endpoint distance is at most a nonnegative explicit tolerance, using subtraction by default or a caller metric(lower_endpoint, upper_endpoint). Preserve external bounds and class, never mutate the source, and optionally return the exact added gap intervals. Support numeric/Decimal and timedelta distances, zero-width missing points, empty input, and propagate metric errors; reject negative/NaN tolerance and negative metric results. This is explicitly approximate and must not change exact union/overlap semantics.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
